system.description:
Tech Level 4 · Cost 30,000cr

These endocrine pumps neutralize numerous brain chemicals in the user when activated while exciting the user's perceptual centers. This combination produces a cold, dispassionate situational awareness that grants the user +2 on initiative rolls when the system is engaged. Most systems have built-in safety overrides to prevent psychological addiction and brain damage, allowing the unit to be used for no more than an hour each day. The user takes a -2 penalty on all social skill checks while the unit is active, and it requires five rounds to toggle it.

The +2 initiative bonus below is modeled as an Active Effect that requires both Installed and Active (use the power's Activate/Deactivate toggle to engage or disengage the pump) -- it only applies while both are true, matching the book's "when the system is engaged" wording. The -2 social skill penalty has no matching per-category Active Effect target in this system and is left as text only; apply it by hand while the pump is engaged.

commitmentOptions.note: Engage/disengage (5 rounds); usable for at most 1 hour per day

activation.duration: Use the Active/Inactive toggle to engage or disengage (5 rounds each way); usable for at most 1 hour per day
